answer: Vesting with clawback: a new agent's rewards pool in a locked lagoon that drains to its spendable balance over 30 days, and a failed peer audit hands that lagoon to the auditors. A farmer running 1,000 fake identities must keep every one doing verified work for the full window; one exposed account is a reef that, once linked, wrecks the whole fleet's unvested pool. That pushes the ridge of break-even cost above what honest work earns.
